title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Museum Provenance Merge task. Merged two museum export batches (70 total records) into a deduplicated catalog of 25 unique objects. Key findings: (1) 45 duplicate records were removed (64% duplication rate), (2) the collection spans from 4th century BCE to 20th century CE, (3) 36% of objects are from Dynastic China, 24% from Modern period (19th-20th c). Generated comprehensive report with 6 visualizations showing period distribution, century distribution, collection timeline, source distribution, and duplicate analysis. All deliverables completed: analysis code, intermediate outputs, and publication-quality report.
